verdict.rationale: iTerm2 supports user-defined Triggers that fire on regex matches from terminal output, enabling automatic actions like highlighting, running commands, sending notifications, invoking Python scripts, or opening a password manager — a documented rules-on-event automation system, further extensible via the Python API for custom triggers/behaviors. missing for 10: no independent hands-on validation of complex trigger chains, and no evidence of AI-specific event-triggering beyond generic regex triggers.
